title: Barotrauma RPG Rules Wiki
description: A structured wiki conversion of the Barotrauma RPG manuscript, separating core rules, character creation, classes, talents, combat, advancement, campaign procedures, equipment, submarines, events, sanity, salvage, and reference material into searchable entries.

source.title: Barotrauma RPG
source.conversionPolicy: Preserve the manuscript's intent, identify unresolved contradictions, normalize presentation, and do not silently invent missing rules.

disclaimer: Unofficial fan-made tabletop material inspired by Barotrauma. This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by the creators or publishers of Barotrauma.

sourceSectionsRemaining: Personal Combat, Damage, Repairs, Disease and Death
